correctness.rationale: For iid uniform endpoint chords, conditional cross-probability p(w)=w-w^2/2; integrals yield E p=1/3 and Var(p)=1/45. The degenerate Hoeffding remainder is orthogonal across pairs, of variance 8/45 per pair; hence exact n-size residual, predicted and total variances. Indicator covariance is the integral of the projection kernel. Calculus has one optimum. Donsker plus the exact integration-by-parts identity proves joint convergence, with L2 error O(1/n) after n^(-3/2) normalization. Code reproduces 716 finite rational/enumeration/simulation checks, which are corroboration, not infinite proof.

value.rationale: The question of which observable aspect of a random chord configuration drives the classical crossing CLT is natural. This result explicitly identifies the entire leading crossing fluctuation with a linear functional of the empirical geometric length bridge; gives exact n-dependent explained variance and residual, and derives a unique optimal observable cutoff from a complete covariance profile. Those are structural quantitative predictions not furnished by the known univariate CLT.
